Initial release — comprehensive career acceleration support system.

- Guides users through self-assessment, career strategy, and goal-setting using structured templates and matrices.

- Includes detailed frameworks for resume/CV engineering, optimization, and ATS compliance with scoring rubrics and tailoring checklists.
- Covers end-to-end job search operations, from networking to offer negotiation and long-term career planning.
- Designed for any role, level, or industry.
